---
title: "Data Collection Consent (GDPR)"
---
As part of this study conducted by ESTIA, we collect certain data for academic research purposes. 

- Data collected: Questionnaire responses (anonymous or indirectly identifying with e-mail adress). 
- Purpose: Used only for research analysis, not shared with third parties. 
- Data retention: 2 years then anonymized. 
- Your rights: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting a.abiakle@estia.fr. 
- Voluntary participation : You can leave the questionnaire at any time. 

By continuing you agree to take part in this study.
